description.narrative: Goal: To promote the participation of all sectors in the operationalization and implementation of the CSA (Climate-Smart Agriculture) policy in Savannakhet and Luang Prabang provinces. Objectives: - To raise awareness and understanding among provincialand district-level government partners regarding the operationalization of the CSA policy into concrete implementation plans at the provincial and district levels. - To facilitate the drafting of implementation plans or the integration of CSA policy implementation into relevant sectors and the allocation of budgets at the provincial and district levels. - To enhance coordination, cooperation, and participation among government partners, local authorities, Lao civil society organizations, and farmer groups (including women and youth) concerning the implementation of the CSA policy. -To disseminate information and raise awareness about the CSA policy to promote itsimplementation at the local level. Project Outcomes: - Help increase awareness and understanding among provincial and district-level government officials regarding the CSA policy and its operationalization into draft implementation plans or integration with existing plans at the provincial and district levels. This will enable provinces anddistricts to have implementation plans that can be proposed for budget allocation from CSA programs or for discussion with other donors (1 provincial plan). This project will also collaborate with another association receiving a small grant from the project to support district-level government partners in drafting implementation plans at the district level. - Facilitate the establishment of technical teams to promote the operationalization of the CSA policy at the provincial and district levels. This willlead to increased coordination and collaboration among government partners, resulting in a technical team (15 individuals) to support the drafting and implementation of CSA plans at the provincial and district levels. - Ensure that Lao civil society organization partners, local authorities, and farmer group leaders/representatives gain knowledge in analyzing gaps, issues, and lessons learned from policy implementation. The project will create a platform for exchange and learning among government partners, civil society organizations, and farmer groups (1 event). The project will collect evidence-based data for policy dialogue on at least 3 issues. - Work with local media to disseminate information about the policy and promote its implementation at the provincial, district, and village levels.

participating-org.narrative: The Disadvantage Children and Youth Development Association (DCYA) is a legally registered as Lao non-profit association. Vision: Children, youth, women, people with disabilities, and the elderly are safe and have a stable income Mission: To rise the capacity ofchildren, youth, women, and people with disabilities to achieve self-reliance, self-sufficiency, and self-empowerment. Our missionis grounded in four pillars: (1) prevent and protect of the most vulnerable, (2) creating an opportunity for livelihood and economic empowerment for vulnerable women, youth and child's family, (3) promote access to basic nutrition, hygiene and sanitation, and (4)promote of sustainable natural resources management.
